Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

hackerrank-community-graded-submissions · documents: HackerRank describes each community submission as linked to a problem statement, constraints, reference solution, hidden tests and checker, submitted code, verdict, runtime, memory, test-level results, edit history, difficulty and topic/skill tags.

Permanent record ID: candidate.third11.hackerrank-community.record-schema.v2

  • The public description identifies record fields; it does not expose the complete submission collection or independently establish label correctness.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

hackerrank-community-graded-submissions · documents: HackerRank explicitly limits the advertised graded-submission library to community data and excludes confidential customer data; its report describes this stream as human community data used for interview preparation.

Permanent record ID: candidate.third11.hackerrank-community.scope.v2

  • Public description does not itself grant a redistribution or training license for the full library.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

hackerrank-community-graded-submissions · dataset size: HackerRank’s captured Bench page describes a community library of more than 2,000 questions and 470 million graded submissions, growing by about 5 million submissions per month.

Permanent record ID: candidate.third11.hackerrank-community.units.v2

  • These are publisher-reported library and growth units, not a count of unique developers, delivered training records or an independently downloaded corpus.
